title: Algebraic closure over a transcendence-basis polynomial subalgebra
statement: Let $F\to E$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] with $E$ algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $v:I\to E$ be a transcendence basis over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis]. The polynomial subalgebra $A=F[v_i:i\in I]\subseteq E$ is a domain, and $E$ is algebraically closed and algebraic over $A$, so it is an algebraic closure of the fraction field of $A$. In Mathlib this is expressed by $\operatorname{IsAlgClosure}(A,E)$.

source.place: Tag 030E (definition-transcendence), part (4), together with Definition 09GS of algebraic closure; read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/030E

proof.text: By the definition of a transcendence basis, E is algebraic over the rational function field F(v). Clearing denominators makes this equivalent to algebraicity over A. E is algebraically closed by hypothesis. Apply IsAlgClosed.isAlgClosure_of_transcendence_basis; A is a domain as a subalgebra of a field.
